title: OpenCode conversations
help: Select an exact database file. Scanning stays local; only an explicit start sends selected excerpts to your model. Verified profile: OpenCode v1.19.5.
save_help: Save source selection before previewing a newly enabled database.
limits: At most 2 selected parts and 12 model requests per preview. Resuming keeps the same allowance.
restart_help: A new scan includes later conversations and preserves the previous checkpoint.
scanning: Scanning a bounded local page. No model calls.
prepared: {parts} selected parts are ready. Review them before organizing.
partial: More local input remains. Scan the next page to continue.
complete: This scan is complete; no pending parts remain.
source_changed: Consumed source content changed. Start a fresh scan before continuing.
unsupported_source_format: This database format is not supported. Try an OpenCode export JSON instead.
source_locked: The database is busy. Retry later or upload an export JSON.
source_denied: This source is not selected or is excluded.
staging_limit: The retained scan reached its storage allowance. Previous checkpoints are preserved.
bounded_read: The local scan reached its limit. Scan the next page to continue.
stopped: Scan stopped; retained input is preserved.
unavailable: Could not prepare this source. Check the selection and server, then retry.
import_active: Another knowledge job is running. Stop it or wait before preparing another preview.
